  }
  function messageFromBody(body){
    if (!body || typeof body !== 'object') return '';
    var error = (body.error && typeof body.error === 'object') ? body.error : null;
    return readableText(body.message_ar) || readableText(body.message) ||
      readableText(error && error.message_ar) || readableText(error && error.message) ||
      humanDetail(body.detail);
  }
  function rateLimitMessage(res, serverMessage){
    var retryAfter = readableText(res && res.retryAfter);
    var waitText = '';
    if (retryAfter && /^\d+$/.test(retryAfter)){
      var seconds = parseInt(retryAfter, 10);
      if (seconds >= 3600) waitText = ' بعد ' + Math.ceil(seconds / 3600) + ' ساعة';
      else if (seconds >= 60) waitText = ' بعد ' + Math.ceil(seconds / 60) + ' دقيقة';
      else waitText = ' بعد ' + seconds + ' ثانية';
    } else if (retryAfter){
      waitText = ' بعد ' + retryAfter;
    }
    return 'لقد أرسلت طلبات كثيرة، حاول مرة أخرى بعد قليل' + waitText + (serverMessage ? '. ' + serverMessage : '.');
  }
  function submissionError(res){
    var body = res && res.data;
    var serverMessage = localizeServerMessage(messageFromBody(body), res && res.status);
    if (res && (res.status === 503 || (body && body.code === 'identity_unavailable'))){
      return 'الخدمة غير متاحة مؤقتًا، من فضلك حاول بعد قليل' + (serverMessage ? '. ' + serverMessage : '.');
    }
    if (res && res.status === 429) return rateLimitMessage(res, serverMessage);
    if (res && res.status === 409) return serverMessage || 'تعذّر إرسال طلبك، حاول مرة أخرى.';
    return serverMessage || 'تعذّر إرسال طلبك، حاول مرة أخرى.';
  }
  function handleSubmitAttempt(){
      if (busy || checkingPhoneStatus) return;
      if (!phoneRecheckPassed){
        checkingPhoneStatus = true;
        if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = true;
        var currentPhoneEl = root.querySelector(applicantType === 'student' ? '[data-role-panel="student"] input[data-student-phone]' : '[data-role-panel="guardian"] input[data-guardian-phone]');
        var currentPhone = normPhone((currentPhoneEl || {}).value || '');
        getPhoneStatus(currentPhone).then(function(status){
          checkingPhoneStatus = false;
          if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = false;
          applyPhoneStatus(status, currentPhoneEl);
          // An existing account never blocks by itself (the Platform links
          // the application to it); only an explicit can_apply === false does.
          if (status && status.canApply === false){
            if (status.error === 'invalid_phone') showError(status.message || PHONE_INVALID_AR);
            return;
          }
          phoneRecheckPassed = true;
          handleSubmitAttempt();
        });
        return;
      }
      phoneRecheckPassed = false;
      if (!selectedGroup){ showError('اختر مجموعة أولًا من القائمة أعلاه.'); closeApplyDialog(); scrollToGroupsList(); return; }
      if (inlineApplication && !applicantType){ showError('اختر طالبًا أو ولي أمر أولًا.'); return; }
      var consentEl = root.querySelector('[data-consent-checkbox]');
      var stageGradeRequired = !!root.querySelector('[data-student-stage] option:not([value=""])') ||
                                !!root.querySelector('[data-child-stage] option:not([value=""])');

      var jobs = []; // array of payload objects, one apply call each

      if (applicantType === 'student'){
        var studentNameEl = root.querySelector('[data-role-panel="student"] input[data-student-name]');
        var studentPhoneEl = root.querySelector('[data-role-panel="student"] input[data-student-phone]');
        var name = (studentNameEl || {}).value || '';
        var phone = normPhone((studentPhoneEl || {}).value || '');
        var stageEl = root.querySelector('select[data-student-stage], input[data-student-stage]');
        var gradeEl = root.querySelector('select[data-student-grade], input[data-student-grade]');
        name = name.trim();
        if (name.length < 2){ showFieldError(studentNameEl, 'من فضلك اكتب الاسم.'); return; }
        if (digitsOf(phone).length < 8){ showFieldError(studentPhoneEl, 'من فضلك اكتب رقم هاتف صحيح.'); return; }
        if (stageGradeRequired && stageEl && !stageEl.value){ showFieldError(stageEl, 'من فضلك اختر المرحلة.'); return; }
        if (stageGradeRequired && gradeEl && !gradeEl.disabled && !gradeEl.value){ showFieldError(gradeEl, 'من فضلك اختر الصف.'); return; }
        var p = basePayload();
        p.applicant_name = name;
        p.phone = phone;
        p.applicant_type = 'student';
        p.student_name = '';
        p.stage = (stageEl && stageEl.value) || selectedGroup.stage;
        p.grade = (gradeEl && gradeEl.value) || selectedGroup.grade;
        jobs.push(p);
      } else {
        var guardianNameEl = root.querySelector('[data-role-panel="guardian"] input[data-guardian-name]');
        var guardianPhoneEl = root.querySelector('[data-role-panel="guardian"] input[data-guardian-phone]');
        var gName = ((guardianNameEl || {}).value || '').trim();
        var gPhone = normPhone((guardianPhoneEl || {}).value || '');
        if (gName.length < 2){ showFieldError(guardianNameEl, 'من فضلك اكتب اسم ولي الأمر.'); return; }
        if (digitsOf(gPhone).length < 8){ showFieldError(guardianPhoneEl, 'من فضلك اكتب رقم هاتف ولي الأمر.'); return; }
        var blocks = childrenWrap ? Array.prototype.slice.call(childrenWrap.querySelectorAll('[data-child-block]')) : [];
        if (!blocks.length){ showError('أضف بيانات ابن واحد على الأقل.'); return; }
        for (var i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++){
          var block = blocks[i];
          var childName = ((block.querySelector('[data-child-name]') || {}).value || '').trim();
          var childStageEl = block.querySelector('[data-child-stage]');
          var childGradeEl = block.querySelector('[data-child-grade]');
          var relationshipEl = block.querySelector('[data-child-relationship]');
          var relationshipCode = (relationshipEl && relationshipEl.value) || '';
          var sameEl = block.querySelector('[data-child-samephone]');
          var isSame = !sameEl || sameEl.checked;
          var childPhoneRaw = normPhone((block.querySelector('[data-child-phone]') || {}).value || '');
          var ordinal = formatCount(i + 1);
          if (childName.length < 2){ showFieldError(block.querySelector('[data-child-name]'), 'من فضلك اكتب اسم الابن رقم ' + ordinal + '.'); return; }
          if (stageGradeRequired && childStageEl && !childStageEl.value){ showFieldError(childStageEl, 'من فضلك اختر مرحلة الابن رقم ' + ordinal + '.'); return; }
          if (stageGradeRequired && childGradeEl && !childGradeEl.disabled && !childGradeEl.value){ showFieldError(childGradeEl, 'من فضلك اختر صف الابن رقم ' + ordinal + '.'); return; }
          if (!relationshipCode){ showFieldError(relationshipEl, 'من فضلك اختر صلة القرابة للابن رقم ' + ordinal + '.'); return; }
          if (!isSame && digitsOf(childPhoneRaw).length < 8){ showFieldError(block.querySelector('[data-child-phone]'), 'من فضلك اكتب رقم هاتف صحيح للابن رقم ' + ordinal + '، أو فعّل "نفس رقمي".'); return; }
          var cp = basePayload();
          cp.applicant_name = gName;
          cp.phone = gPhone;
          cp.applicant_type = 'guardian';
          cp.student_name = childName;
          cp.stage = (childStageEl && childStageEl.value) || selectedGroup.stage;
          cp.grade = (childGradeEl && childGradeEl.value) || selectedGroup.grade;
          if (relationshipCode) cp.relationship_code = relationshipCode;
          if (!isSame) cp.child_phone = childPhoneRaw;
          jobs.push(cp);
        }
      }

      if (consentEl && !consentEl.checked){
        showFieldError(consentEl, 'يجب الموافقة على الشروط وسياسة الخصوصية للمتابعة.'); return;
      }

      busy = true; if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = true;
      var successMsg = '';
      var submissionResults = [];
      var failedJobIds = [];
      var hasNonAccountFailure = false;
      if (retryJobIds){
        var allCurrentJobs = jobs;
        var retryLookup = {};
        retryJobIds.forEach(function(id){ retryLookup[id] = true; });
        jobs = jobs.filter(function(job){ return !!retryLookup[jobId(job)]; });
        if (!jobs.length){ retryJobIds = null; jobs = allCurrentJobs; }
      }
      clearSubmissionResults();
      (function runSequentially(idx){
        if (idx >= jobs.length){
          busy = false; if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = false;
          if (failedJobIds.length){
            retryJobIds = failedJobIds;
            showSubmissionResults(submissionResults);
            if (hasNonAccountFailure){
              showError('تعذّر إرسال بعض الطلبات. راجع حالة كل ابن ثم أعد إرسال الطلبات التي لم تنجح.');
            }
            return;
          }
          retryJobIds = null;
          if (successMsg){
            var msgEl = root.querySelector('[data-success-msg]');
            if (msgEl) msgEl.textContent = successMsg;
          }
          setupStoreLinks();
          goStep('success');
          return;
        }
        submitOne(jobs[idx]).then(function(res){
          if (responseSucceeded(res)){
            submissionResults.push({ ok: true, label: jobs[idx].student_name || 'الطلب', message: (res.data && res.data.message) || 'تم الإرسال بنجاح' });
            if (res.data.message) successMsg = res.data.message;
            runSequentially(idx + 1);
            return;
          }
          submissionResults.push({ ok: false, label: jobs[idx].student_name || 'الطلب', message: submissionError(res) });
          failedJobIds.push(jobId(jobs[idx]));
          if (res.data && res.data.code === 'phone_has_active_account'){
            setPhoneBlocked(true);
          } else {
            hasNonAccountFailure = true;
            showError(submissionError(res));
          }
          runSequentially(idx + 1);
        }).catch(function(){
          submissionResults.push({ ok: false, label: jobs[idx].student_name || 'الطلب', message: 'تعذّر إرسال طلبك، حاول مرة أخرى' });
          failedJobIds.push(jobId(jobs[idx]));
          runSequentially(idx + 1);
          showError(NETWORK_ERROR_MESSAGE);
        });
      })(0);
  }
  if (inlineApplication && applyDialog && applyDialog.tagName === 'FORM'){
    applyDialog.addEventListener('submit', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); handleSubmitAttempt(); });
  } else if (submitBtn) submitBtn.addEventListener('click', handleSubmitAttempt);

  // ---- Clickable step-dot navigation (1 بياناتك / ✓ نجاح): back is
  // always free (nothing is ever cleared from the DOM), forward re-runs
  // the EXACT same validation as the submit button -- on failure it shows
  // the inline error and stays put; on success it performs the real
  // submission (payload/endpoint untouched), never a faked success state.
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-step-dot]').forEach(function(dot){
    var targetStep = dot.getAttribute('data-step-dot');
    dot.addEventListener('click', function(){
      if (dot.getAttribute('aria-current') === 'step') return;
      if (targetStep === 'applicant'){
        goStep('applicant');
      } else if (targetStep === 'success'){
        handleSubmitAttempt();
      }
    });
  });
})();
</script>
